summaries.solve: Solve a required plain-language goal; defaults to 5 iterations. Next: show.
summaries.run: Run a scenario (required unless configured); defaults to 1 iteration. Next: status.
summaries.status: Show a required run's current snapshot; defaults to text output. Queue: autoctx queue status. Next: watch.
summaries.watch: Follow a required run; defaults to polling every 2 seconds. Next: show.
summaries.show: Inspect a required run; defaults to its latest generation. Next: export.
summaries.export: Export a required run or scenario; defaults to JSON on stdout. Next: import-package.
